messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

function.name: get_co_ordinate
function.description: Fetch geographical coordinates of a particular location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city name you want coordinates for.

message.content:
The time difference depends on whether each city is observing Daylight Saving Time (DST) at the moment you’re asking:

| Period | Los Angeles (PT) | Berlin (CET/CEST) | Difference |
|--------|------------------|-------------------|------------|
| Standard Time (winter) | UTC‑08:00 | UTC+01:00 | **+9 hours** (Berlin is 9 h ahead) |
| Daylight Saving Time (summer) | UTC‑07:00 | UTC+02:00 | **+10 hours** (Berlin is 10 h ahead) |

**How it works**

* Los Angeles switches from Pacific Standard Time (PST, UTC‑8) to Pacific Daylight Time (PDT, UTC‑7) usually on the second Sunday in March and reverts on the first Sunday in November.
* Berlin switches from Central European Time (CET, UTC+1) to Central European Summer Time (CEST, UTC+2) on the last Sunday in March and reverts on the last Sunday in October.

So if you’re looking at a date in, say, July, Berlin will be 10 hours ahead of Los Angeles. If it’s December, the gap is 9 hours.
